question: Which answer figure is the mirror image of the question figure? (Mirror on the right side, line XY.)

why: The mirror swaps left and right. The big triangle stays the same, and the small black triangle moves from the left side to the right side at the same height. That is option 3. Options 2 and 4 move the black triangle to the bottom, which a side mirror never does.
trick: Keep the height of every part the same; only change its side.
